description.en:
General map 1:1 000 000 is a dataset depicting the terrain of the whole of Finland. General map 1:1 000 000 has been produced by using data from Topographic map 1:250 000, Map names of the product Geographic names and Municipal division 1:1 000 000. The key objects on General map 1: 1 000 000 waterways, the traffic route network and administrative borders. General map 1:1 000 000 is available as a version that covers the whole country. The product is in vector format.

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)
